event: Wes Doyle and Cass Deveaux are seen arguing in the street loud enough that people stop.

name: Wes Doyle
action: rolls over to avoid direct eye contact with Kohl
thought: he'll never leave me alone, why does he even care?

speech.text: can't sleep with all this going on

name: Junie Marsh
action: gulps water and looks at Ruiz, then Adeyemi
thought: I wish it would all just end, I'm so tired

speech.text: you're not going to make me work tomorrow, are you?

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: shifts uncomfortably
thought: I'm so deep in this, I don't know what to do

speech.text: hey, man, what's going on?

name: Rey Vasquez
action: sits up straight
thought: I just need to stay calm and figure this out

name: Cass Deveaux
action: smiles at Dot
thought: I'm always one step ahead, they don't know what's coming

speech.text: nice evening, isn't it?

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: stretches and lies back down
thought: I'll deal with Okonkwo later, now I just need sleep

speech.text: goodnight, baby

name: Gus Petrakis
action: twitches in his sleep
thought: what's going on with Lyle and Reyes?

name: Malik Reyes
action: shivers in the cold
thought: I have to get to the bottom of this, I know something's off

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: stretches and closes his eyes
thought: I just want a quiet life, is that too much to ask?

speech.text: goodnight, baby

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: sits up slightly
thought: I just want to be able to speak out without consequence

speech.text: you're not going to take me away from my family, are you?

name: Femi Adeyemi
action: nods off to sleep
thought: I wish Simone would just take a break from it all

name: Junie Marsh
action: wiping down the counter again, for the hundredth time
thought: maybe I'll escape this cycle if I just work hard enough

speech.text: Gus needs a new break, can we give them a five-minute

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: putting the cash in the register and counting it twice
thought: I need to get Lyle off my back, I just don't know how

speech.text: Marcus, can you tell Ms. Calloway I owe her money?

name: Sticks
action: sitting on the bench, lost in thought
thought: I'm invisible to most people, but Marcus sees me

speech.text: Marcus gave me a cup of coffee on the coldest night of the year

name: Gus Petrakis
action: pouring coffee for the customer
thought: I don't know how much longer I can keep running this place

speech.text: Nadia, can you take this order for me?

name: Malik Reyes
action: sitting on the bench, staring at the package
thought: Dez is hiding something, and I need to uncover it

name: Rey Vasquez
action: restocking the shelves
thought: I need to retire safely, but I don't know how

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: talking to the group at the table
thought: I've been tracking Lyle's corruption for years

speech.text: Gus, I think we're getting close to exposing Lyle

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: watching the door, waiting for customers
thought: The block is on the brink of disaster, I need to keep it together

speech.text: Cass, can you keep an eye on the door for a minute?

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: nursing her drink, listening to the conversation
thought: I need to find more about the truth, but I don't know where to start

speech.text: Det. Ruiz, can I ask you something?

name: Cass Deveaux
action: counting out change, smiling at Ms. Calloway
thought: I've seen property values fluctuate wildly on this block before

speech.text: Ms. Calloway, I'll take care of it for you

name: Amara Bello
action: wiping down the counter, humming a tune
thought: I need to get my own shop going, but my brother is holding me back

speech.text: Tee, can we talk about my shop idea?

event: Notices go up on two doors in the Terraces. The letterhead is a company nobody has heard of.

name: Malik Reyes
action: looks around the group, then at Tee
thought: What's really going on here?

speech.text: Tee, what's going on with Dez?

name: Junie Marsh
action: fidgets with her hands, trying to avoid the conversation
thought: Why do I always get stuck with the hard stuff?

speech.text: Simone, can we talk about something else?

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: nervously glances at Booker, then back at the queue
thought: I really don't want to owe anyone anything else

speech.text: Booker, I really need to talk to you about this debt

name: Rey Vasquez
action: stares blankly ahead, lost in thought
thought: I'll never be able to retire safely if I don't make a change

name: Sgt. Hal Brennan
action: sighs, rubbing his temples
thought: Just one more year and I can retire already

name: Wes Doyle
action: studies the contents of his mailbox
thought: I really need to do something about this Lyle situation

speech.text: Gus, have you seen anything unusual lately?

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: listens attentively to Malik, then responds
thought: What's really going on with Dez?

speech.text: Malik, Dez is always looking out for himself. He's not the kind of guy you can rely on

name: Gus Petrakis
action: sits in silence, lost in thought
thought: Booker will stop at nothing to ruin me

name: Dot Feeney
action: pours a drink for Brennan
thought: Booker's always been a little too smooth for my taste

speech.text: Hal, you okay? You look a bit stressed

name: Sticks
action: sits in silence, staring into the distance
thought: I'm just invisible to most people, but Marcus sees my worth

name: Adaeze Okonkwo
action: looks up from her meal, concerned
thought: I really need to get my son out of this city

event: The Harbor Bar is full and loud and for a few hours nothing is wrong.

name: Junie Marsh
action: Junie rolls over in bed, her eyes open a crack.
thought: Great, now Reyes is stuck in my head.

speech.text: Do you ever feel like you're just waiting for something to happen?

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Kohl tosses and turns in his sleep, his face twisted in anxiety.
thought: How am I going to get out of this? Lyle is going to kill me.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Rey lies awake, his mind racing with thoughts of Dez and the package.
thought: I have to get to the bottom of this; Dez is putting me in harm's way.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: Simone gets out of bed to get a glass of water.
thought: I should really get some rest, but I'm too anxious about what's going on.

name: Gus Petrakis
action: Gus sleeps soundly, his face calm and peaceful.
thought: I wish I could just sell the Blue Spoon and retire already.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Malik lies awake, his eyes fixed on the ceiling.
thought: I'm in this too deep now, I have to see it through.

name: Wes Doyle
action: Wes sleeps fitfully, his face twisted in anxiety.
thought: I have to get out of this; Lyle is going to ruin me.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Ruiz lies awake, her mind racing with thoughts of Lyle and his corruption.
thought: I've been tracking Lyle's corruption for years, it's only a matter of time before he gets caught.

name: Sticks
action: Sticks smokes quietly under the flyover.
thought: Marcus sees my worth, he gives me a chance.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: Tee sleeps soundly, his face calm and peaceful.
thought: I hope Amara can take over the diner, she deserves it.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Dez sleeps fitfully, his face twisted in anxiety.
thought: I have to protect my empire at all costs.
